text_by_language.en: IMD Guwahati has issued forecast for Thunderstorm with Lightning which is very likely to occur at a few places over Kamrup and Kamrup Metropolitan in next 3 hours. Issued in Public Interest by ASDMA.
text_by_language.hi: Thunderstorm with Lightning: IMD Guwahati has issued forecast for Thunderstorm with Lightning which is very likely to occur at a few places over Kamrup and Kamrup Metropolitan in next 3 hours. Issued in Public Interest by ASDMA.
